STEP 1 OF 3 — PERSONAL BRAND

Four directions, four different bets — not four shades of one idea. Each card shows the wordmark, the type pairing, the palette and one applied fragment, plus an honest why/cost.

Pick one (or tell me to cross-breed two). That choice settles step 2, the design system, which then settles step 3, the portfolio build.

My recommendation, developed one step further so you can judge it at real size: 1440x900, the actual first viewport.

Why C leads: you build graphics tools, so a live field argues the point faster than any copy can — and it makes "no origins" literal, structure emerging from nothing.

If the upkeep worries you, A is the safe pick and D is the fast one.

CHECK MY FACTS

Project one-liners are drafted from what I know of your repos — Visual Labs, Realm, Vibe Check, No Origins. Correct anything wrong.

[EMAIL] in the footer is a deliberate placeholder; I did not want to publish your work address on a personal site.

Still open: who this site is for, and whether Notes/About earn their place.
